payload.title: File:Halisaurus auriculatus (holotype, NVP040).png
payload.credit_html: "A new species of halisaurine mosasaurid from the Upper Cretaceous of Egypt"
payload.description_html: Halisaurine mosasaurid Halisaurus auriculatus, holotype (NVP040), Teneida, Dakhla Oasis, Western Desert, Egypt, lower Maastrichtian. Skull restoration (composite using bones from left and right sides of the skull, only right maxilla shown reversed).
